Well that was an awesome game last night. Visionary, Tempest, and Absolute Zero against the evil Citizen Dawn on the Wagner Mars Base. The battle started off wonderfully, everyone had cards in hand that they couldn't wait to get into play, but then we did Citizen's Dawn's setup with the dreaded Anvil and Truth combo coming out. After getting rid of those two everything was going smooth, Absolute Zero was set up with his modules, apperatures, and even thermal shockwave. Tempest was nearly complete as well with all his badness ready. Visionary was ready to destroy any ongoing that came into play and I believe another card as well... Then it all changed again with a Devastating Aurora. Clearing the field of anything. At one point Tempest was even as far down as 3 health, he became the healer for awhile.

 

Closer to the end of the battle it became significantly easier as all her worst cards had already been out, so it was just clearing out the rest of her health. With Lightning Slash appearing two turns in a row, Absolute Zero enjoying hurting himself a little too much, and Visionary keeping the ongoings at bay and dealing a little bit of damage herself.

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked:
Earlier today we had a total of four games. First game was against Plague Rat and the heroes suffered a sad defeat, I believe the line up was RC Wraith, Absolute Zero, and Engine Bunker (can't remember the actual turn order though) in the Tomb of Anubis. Plague Rat seems to always cause a lot of problems on all these online games. I don't think any pairings we've had against him thus far have been a hero victory.

 

The next exciting game was against GloomWeaver, using Greatest Legacy, Redeem Fanatic, Absolute Zero, and... oh yes NightMist in the Wagner Mars Base. The heroes emerged victorious in this battle, and were pretty much on top of things the entire time. Was nice playing a four player game again aswell.

 

Next up on the list Wraith, Bunker, and Young Legacy took on Spite in the Realm of Discord. The battle was scarce, aside from Bunker who stood pretty nearly the whole time. Both Young Legacy and Wraith were eventually incapacitated with Bunker at 17 health. We eventually ruled that heroes would win since nothing could happen that would screw up the plan so badly that it would of resulted in a loss, so no point in dragging it out as it would of been awhile before Spite would of actually fallen.

 

The final game had a returning Absolute Zero (the randomizer loved him that day), Unity, and Tachyon facing Akash'Bhuta in the Tomb of Anubis. This was probably one of the most exciting battles to ever take place. The fact that it was so close that if it would of lasted another round the heroes would of been the losers was so intense. The close battles are always fun to be apart of. Absolute Zero was incapacitated in the final Round on his own turn, Unity was down to 2 and Tachyon was down to 3. It didn't help that all 3 construction pylons were on the bottom 10 cards of the deck, also the Flash Forged were only a few cards higher than that.

posts.name: Garou
posts.cooked: A battle to be remembered, indeed. I sure am glad that I didn't have to do the maintenance on the environment and villain decks, though...

posts.name: Mezike
posts.cooked:
Yeah, that Akash Bhuta and Temple of Anubis combo was just comical at times, especially with all the interleaving card effects. It was a long game, the majority of which was taken up with managing those decks. Pretty close at the end too - although I had another lightspeed barrage in hand and there were plenty of options to easily kill off the couple of carapaces that were just about hanging on, we were all very low on health and probably wouldn't have lasted long enough to see another round.

 

That hero combo we had against Spite in the Realm of Discord was a bit iffy. With RC Wraith and Young Legacy incapacitated their abilities were enough with Bunkers plating to prevent any damage going to him and to feed him enough cards to keep his Gatling Gun in play. We could have sat there forever while Bunker cleaned out his entire deck, but I guess it is a very situational combination.
